'''Imodin Ganalya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scientist/Legends|Scientist]] of the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], she was stationed at the [[Outpost Eudor]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] where she developed an experimental extermination serum called "[[Mother's Milk project|Mother's Milk]]" to destroy [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[Sabas]] hive in the [[Kaamos Territory]]. She sent an armed squad of Imperial soldiers to test the serum on Killik eggs, but after they were overwhelmed and killed she had to ask an Imperial hero to recover the serum and complete the fallen squad's mission.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
